name: QUEUED_TRAFFIC_YELLOW_DIAMOND

qld_w5-q13_queued_cars.desc: three queued cars seen from behind, stepped up to the right (black bodies, yellow rear windows, red tail lights), box f 210 left / g 222 right of centre, e 158 above / d 142 below; vector paths from the PDF (items 22-33), 445.4 x 309.2 as drawn on the sheet's 600 sign
qld_w5-q13_queued_cars.vector: extracted from the sheet PDF (not traced)

notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q13 'Queued traffic - symbolic' warning sign (2023). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Symbol box from the table: f 210 left and g 222 right of the vertical centreline (432 wide), e 158 above and d 142 below the horizontal centreline (300 tall): x 214.27, y 266.27. The symbol is the sheet PDF's own vector paths (tools/symbols/qld_w5-q13_queued_cars.svg, vec2sym2, not traced): black car bodies, yellow rear windows (the sign's yellow) and red tail lights as the sheet draws them; drawn 445.4 x 309.2 on the sheet's sign (3 % larger than the tabled box), scaled into the box. The sheet's colour legend has its labels swapped (a yellow swatch labelled 'Retroreflective white', a red one 'Retroreflective yellow'): the drawing and the sign are black, yellow and red, and the lights are taken as retroreflective red. Black and red on retroreflective yellow.
